question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Impertinent
solution:
The correct answer is "**Polite**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Impertinent" means showing a lack of respect or rudeness.**(धृष्ट)

 
 
• Example: It would be impertinent of me to ask.
 
 
 
• **"Polite" means showing good manners and respect.**(विनम्र)
 
 
• Example: She is a polite little girl.
 
 
 
 
 
• Antonym means a word that means the opposite of another word.
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate antonym of impertinent is polite.

Hence, **the correct answer i option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2 (Irrelevant) means not related to the subject or situation at hand.(अप्रासंगिक)
 
• Option 3 (Insolent) means showing a rude and arrogant lack of respect.(ढीठ)
 
• Option 4 (Personal) means relating to or concerning a particular person.(निजी)
